description: The main window: read and write the notes folder under the home folder, choose a folder, reveal it in Finder, open an attached file in place with its default app, and open web and mail links (http, https, mailto only). Updates: check for one, download and install it (the update's signature is verified in Rust against plugins.updater.pubkey; the address it checks is fixed in tauri.conf.json, not chosen by the page), and restart into it. On macOS the fs scope never matches a hidden (dot) path component unless a pattern names it literally, so the hidden names the app needs are listed explicitly; nothing else hidden (~/.ssh and so on) is reachable.
